title: Wrist X-ray: healthy vs. distal radius fracture
prompt: Slide the seam left and right to compare a healthy wrist with a wrist that has a distal radius fracture. Notice the cortical step-off and angulation on the fractured side.

before.alt: Anteroposterior radiograph of a healthy wrist with intact distal radius and ulna.
before.caption: Healthy

after.alt: Anteroposterior radiograph of a wrist showing a transverse distal radius fracture with dorsal angulation.
after.caption: Fractured
